note: 2.0.142: contacts list gets a manual WeChat-ID editor and a live ratio. Every row now carries a 「改号」 button that opens a modal prefilled with the current id; saving (or clearing) posts POST /api/native-wechat/contacts/update and refreshes the row plus the new 「已取号 X / Y（Z%）」 chip next to 同步通讯录 (fed by with_wx_no on GET /contacts). The search row gets an inline 全部 / 已有微信号 / 没微信号 dropdown (has_wx=all|yes|no) that reloads page 1 and combines with the keyword. Also repairs the dropdown + chip labels an ASCII-encoded patch had written as '??', and the manual-edit gate accepts phone-style ids while rejecting a nickname/too-short value with a readable Chinese message instead of question marks.
